# Return on investment

Canonical page: https://nepocore.com/tools/roi/

Calculate net gain and return percentage from an initial cost and a final value. Optionally compare an annualized rate over a chosen number of years.

## How to use it

1. Enter the numbers, dates or units you want to compare.
2. Choose the calculation options and calculate.
3. Review the result together with the assumptions shown.

## Example

Compare an investment costing 10000 with a final value of 12500 over two years.

## Limits and checks

This does not model intermediate cash flows, taxes, fees or risk. Annualized return is defined for positive starting and final values.

## Access and processing

Free to use without an account. Interactive processing requires JavaScript in a modern browser. Input is processed in the browser rather than sent to a processing server. Optional browser storage is not a synchronized account.
